title: US mid-terms may help D-Street break free from geopolitical overhang
excerpt: The upcoming US mid-term elections will potentially influence global markets and trade policies. Investors are closely watching whether the outcomes will ease uncertainties regarding tariffs and immigration. The results could shape the policy direction and affect the sentiment of global investors. Analysts suggest that the focus should remain on domestic earnings growth and financial flows.

title: Why mutual fund distributors are giving up multiple licences
excerpt: Mutual fund distributors with multiple AMFI registration numbers are asking asset managers to consolidate them after revised Sebi rules removed the GST-related benefit of splitting commissions.

The dollar dropped against most of its Group-of-10 peers and the yield on the benchmark 10-year Treasury note fell four basis points to 4.92%. The MSCI Asia Pacific Index dropped 0.2% even as South Korea’s Kospi Index jumped 1%.

title: Google responds to political backlash over removing search from schools that ban AI
excerpt: After elected officials voiced outrage over Google turning off search at schools that ban AI, the company said search can be turned back on with AI Overviews.

title: Corporate bond issuances top Rs 17,000 crore as yields ease
excerpt: Corporate debt issuances have seen significant growth as many companies seek to capitalize on favorable borrowing conditions. The aggregate debt proposed to be raised this week surpasses Rs 17,000 crore. Experts suggest that current bond yields below 7.30% may not remain stable for long. The outcome of upcoming US midterm elections may influence future market conditions significantly.

title: RBI's Rs 50,000 crore VRRR faces muted response from market
excerpt: The Reserve Bank of India announced a variable rate reverse repo operation of ₹50,000 crore. This decision came after the banking system liquidity reached nearly ₹2 lakh crore on Monday. Banks opted to bid ₹23,905 crore, reflecting an asymmetry in the banking system's surplus. The weighted average call rate decreased to 5.45% from 5.50% on Monday. Another VRRR operation of ₹50,000 crore is scheduled for Wednesday.

title: Happiest minds Q2 net profit rises 15% as AI uncertainty weighs
excerpt: Happiest Minds Technologies reported a 15.1% increase in net profit for the September quarter compared to the previous year. While revenue grew by 12.5% year-on-year, it reflects ongoing concerns over client decision-making related to artificial intelligence. The company’s managing director noted the challenges of longer sales cycles and uncertain customer investments in AI solutions. Despite a relatively good demand scenario, they are still behind their revenue growth target.

title: Happiest minds Q2 net profit rises 15% as AI uncertainty weighs
excerpt: Happiest Minds Technologies reported a 15.1% increase in net profit for the September quarter compared to the previous year. While revenue grew by 12.5% year-on-year, it reflects ongoing concerns over client decision-making related to artificial intelligence. The company’s managing director noted the challenges of longer sales cycles and uncertain customer investments in AI solutions. Despite a relatively good demand scenario, they are still behind their revenue growth target.

title: US midterm election betting surges past $1.4 billion as Democrats score major wins

title: Rupee rises 14 paise to 94.61 against US dollar during early trade
excerpt:
The rupee strengthened by 14 paise to 94.61 against the US dollar in early trade on Wednesday, supported by receding crude oil prices, a weaker US dollar and inflows of foreign funds.
Buying momentum in the domestic equities market also favoured the Indian currency even as investors awaited the outcome of the US midterm elections, according to forex traders.
In the interbank foreign exchange market, the rupee opened at 94.61 and went up to 94.50 before paring some gains to trade at 94.61 against the greenback, up 14 paise from its previous session's closing level.
The Indian currency rose 9 paise to close at 94.75 against the US dollar on Tuesday.

title: Arisinfra Solutions reports 110% rise in H1 net profit to Rs 42.9 cr
excerpt: Arisinfra Solutions reported a 110% jump in first-half profit as revenue and operating margins improved. Strong growth in contract manufacturing and its Developer as a Service business helped the company post its highest-ever quarterly profit.

ai.title_te: Arisinfra Solutions: H1 లాభం 110% పెరిగి రూ. 42.9 కోట్లకు చేరింది
ai.summary: Arisinfra Solutions తొలి అర్ధవార్షిక (H1) నికర లాభం 110% పెరిగి రూ. 42.9 కోట్లకు చేరింది. రెవెన్యూ మరియు ఆపరేటింగ్ మార్జిన్లు మెరుగుపడటంతో, కంపెనీ తన చరిత్రలోనే అత్యధిక త్రైమాసిక లాభాన్ని నమోదు చేసింది.

ai.why: కంట్రాక్ట్ మ్యాన్యుఫ్యాక్చరింగ్ మరియు DaaS వ్యాపారంలో బలమైన వృద్ధి కంపెనీ భవిష్యత్ ఆదాయ పోటెన్షియల్‌ను సూచిస్తుంది, ఇది ఇన్వెస్టర్ల నమ్మకాన్ని పెంచుతుంది.

ai.impact_reason_te: లాభాల పెరుగుదల మరియు మార్జిన్ల మెరుగుదల కంపెనీ యొక్క ఆర్థిక ఆరోగ్యాన్ని బలపరుస్తుంది, దీనివల్ల EPS (Earnings Per Share) పెరిగి షేర్ ధరకు అనుకూలంగా పనిచేస్తుంది.

title: Why MCX shares slumped 7% after Q2 results, but rose 50% in 2026: More upside ahead or book profits? Experts views

title: BLS Polymers shares rally 6% after strong stock market debut
excerpt: BLS Polymers shares extended their strong debut gains, rising nearly 6% on Wednesday after listing at a 65% premium to the IPO price. The issue received 241 times subscription, while the company reported higher income and profit in FY26.

ai.title_te: BLS Polymers షేర్లు IPO లిస్టింగ్ తర్వాత 6% పెరుగుదల
ai.summary: BLS Polymers షేర్లు IPO ధర కంటే 65% ప్రీమియం‌తో లిస్ట్ అయిన తర్వాత బుధవారం దాదాపు 6% పెరిగాయి. ఈ ఇష్యూకు 241 రెట్లు సబ్‌స్క్రిప్షన్ వచ్చింది. కంపెనీ FY26 లో ఆదాయం మరియు లాభాలు పెరిగినట్లు నివేదికలు చూపిస్తున్నాయి.
ai.summary_te: BLS Polymers షేర్లు IPO ధర కంటే 65% ప్రీమియం‌తో లిస్ట్ అయిన తర్వాత బుధవారం దాదాపు 6% పెరిగాయి. ఈ ఇష్యూకు 241 రెట్లు సబ్‌స్క్రిప్షన్ వచ్చింది. కంపెనీ FY26 లో ఆదాయం మరియు లాభాలు పెరిగినట్లు నివేదికలు చూపిస్తున్నాయి.
ai.why: IPO యొక్క బలమైన డిమాండ్ మరియు కంపెనీ ఆర్థిక పనితీరు చూపిస్తుంది. ఇది పాలిమర్స్ రంగంలో ఇన్వెస్టర్ల ఆసక్తిని సూచిస్తుంది.
ai.why_it_matters_te: IPO యొక్క బలమైన డిమాండ్ మరియు కంపెనీ ఆర్థిక పనితీరు చూపిస్తుంది. ఇది పాలిమర్స్ రంగంలో ఇన్వెస్టర్ల ఆసక్తిని సూచిస్తుంది.
ai.market_impact_te: BLS Polymers షేర్‌పై కొనసాగుతున్న డిమాండ్ వల్ల షార్ట్-టర్మ్ లో అప్‌సైడ్ పొటెన్షియల్ ఉంది.
ai.impact_reason_te: అధిక సబ్‌స్క్రిప్షన్ (241x) మరియు లాభాల పెరుగుదల కంపెనీ యొక్క భవిష్యత్ ఆదాయ ప్రాస్పెక్ట్స్‌ను బలపరుస్తాయి, దీనివల్ల స్టాక్ ధర పెరుగుదలకు దారితీస్తుంది.

title: China Banks' applications for PBOC stock loan scheme exceed 200 billion yuan
excerpt: China's central bank said applications for loans under its stock-purchase financing scheme have exceeded 200 billion yuan. The PBOC has also cut the relending rate to 1%, stepping up efforts to support share buybacks and stabilise equity markets.

title: Titan Company Q2 results preview: Profit may rise up to 27% YoY; jewellery growth, margins in focus

ai.impact_reason_te: US‑లో టెక్‑స్టాక్స్‌కి దిగజారుదల, ఇండియన్ IT, AI‑సంబంధిత కంపెనీలకు మూలధన ప్రవాహం తగ్గుతుంది; సౌర‑ఎనర్జీ స్టాక్స్‌కి US‑పాలసీ సపోర్ట్, ఇండియన్ రిన్యువబుల్ కంపెనీలకు లాభం.

title: Silver prices jump over 4% to reclaim $51/oz as Democrats secure US midterm victory. What’s happening?
excerpt: Silver prices surged over 4% to reclaim the $51/oz mark after Democrats secured a victory in the US midterm elections, weakening the dollar and Treasury yields. However, HSBC expects further gains to be limited as silver trades close to levels justified by fundamentals. Industrial and jewellery demand may weaken, while institutional buying and supply constraints could offer support.

title: BMW Q3 profit falls 15% as China competition weighs
excerpt: BMW reported a 15% year-on-year decline in third-quarter net profit to 1.45 billion euros, a day after issuing its second profit warning of 2026. Intensifying competition from Chinese automakers, rising costs and weaker demand in China are weighing on the German luxury carmaker. Its vehicle deliveries in China plunged 24.8% during the quarter, while global deliveries fell 6.3%.

In a recent podcast, he traced the AI frenzy to ChatGPT's 2022 launch, which brought artificial intelligence into public consciousness. He explained how advances in computing power and access to vast amounts of data have transformed AI and fuelled today's enthusiasm.

title: Rupee gains 17 paise to settle at 94.58 against Us dollar
excerpt: The Indian rupee appreciated for the second consecutive session, closing 17 paise higher against the US dollar. title: Stockal row: Who is liable for unauthorised sale of investors' US shares?

title: Stock Market Rally: Bulls to stay? Nifty, Sensex gain 5.5% in 5 sessions; Can the momentum sustain? Key levels to watch
excerpt: Indian equities extended a five-session rally, with the Nifty 50 gaining 5.55% and the Sensex 5.53%. Broad-based buying, foreign investor inflows, easing crude prices and positive earnings supported sentiment, while IT stocks lagged.

ai.title_te: Nifty‑50, Sensex 5.5% పెరిగాయి: బుల్లిష్ ర్యాలీ కొనసాగుతుందా?
ai.summary: ఇండియన్ ఈక్విటీస్ ఐదు సెషన్ల ర్యాలీని కొనసాగించాయి, Nifty‑50 5.55% మరియు Sensex 5.53% పెరిగాయి. విదేశీ పెట్టుబడిదారుల ప్రవాహం, క్రూడ్ ధరల తగ్గింపు, బలమైన earnings మార్కెట్ సెంటిమెంట్‌ను బలపరిచాయి, IT స్టాక్స్ లాగ్‌గడలేదు.

ai.why: బలమైన ఇండెక్స్ ర్యాలీ పెట్టుబడిదారుల రిస్క్‑అప్ భావనను సూచిస్తుంది, కానీ IT లో బలహీనత సెగ్మెంట్‑వైజ్ రిస్క్‌ను గుర్తిస్తుంది.

ai.market_impact_te: మొత్తం మార్కెట్‌లో కొనుగోలు ఒత్తిడి, బుల్లిష్ టోన్లు కొనసాగే అవకాశం.
ai.impact_reason_te: విదేశీ ఫండ్ల నెట్ ఇన్‌ఫ్లో, క్రూడ్ ధరల తగ్గింపు ద్వారా ఇన్‌పుట్ ఖర్చులు తగ్గి, కంపెనీల లాభదాయకత మెరుగుపడుతుంది; ఇది ఇండెక్స్‌లోని బహుళ స్టాక్స్‌కి బలమైన ధరల మద్దతు ఇస్తుంది.

title: How Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys shares performed post Q2; profit up 51%, ₹5 dividend; what drove performance?
excerpt: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys reported a 51.4% year-on-year rise in September-quarter net profit to ₹147.76 crore, while profit fell 23.3% sequentially. Revenue increased 34.7% annually, and the company declared a ₹5 interim dividend. Shares rose 2.5% to ₹1,126.

ai.title_te: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Q2 లాభం 51% పెరిగింది, 5 రూపాయల డివిడెండ్
ai.summary: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys FY27 Q2లో నెట్ లాభం 51.4% YoY పెరిగి ₹147.76 కోట్లు, రెవెన్యూ 34.7% పెరిగింది. కంపెనీ ₹5 ఇంటర్మీడియట్ డివిడెండ్ ప్రకటించింది, షేర్లు 2.5%上涨.
ai.summary_te: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys FY27 Q2లో నెట్ లాభం 51.4% YoY పెరిగి ₹147.76 కోట్లు, రెవెన్యూ 34.7% పెరిగింది. కంపెనీ ₹5 ఇంటర్మీడియట్ డివిడెండ్ ప్రకటించింది, షేర్లు 2.5%上涨.

ai.market_impact_te: మెటల్స్ స్టాక్స్‌లో బుల్ భావన, ప్రత్యేకంగా ఇండస్ట్రియల్ పెట్టుబడిదారులలో.

title: Auto sales growth to cool post-festive season, says Monarch; bets on Minda Corp, RK Forgings and Sundram Fasteners
excerpt: Auto sales growth is expected to moderate in the second half of FY27 after strong festive demand, while tractor sales may remain weak. Monarch Networth Capital prefers diversified ancillary players Minda Corporation, RK Forgings and Sundram Fasteners, with potential upside of up to 44%.

ai.summary: Monarch Networth Capital FY27 H2లో ఫెస్టివ్‑సీజన్ తర్వాత ఆటో అమ్మకాలు మందగిస్తాయని, ట్రాక్టర్ అమ్మకాలు బలహీనంగా ఉంటాయని అంచనా వేసింది. కంపెనీ Minda Corp, RK Forgings, Sundram Fasteners వంటి అనుబంధ ఆటో భాగాల కంపెనీలలో 44% వరకు upside ఉందని పేర్కొంది.

ai.why_it_matters_te: ఆటో భాగాల కంపెనీలకు పెట్టుబడి ఆసక్తి పెరగడం, వాటి స్టాక్‌లలో బలమైన కొనుగోలు ఒత్తిడిని సృష్టించవచ్చు.

title: U.S. International Trade in Goods and Services, September 2026
excerpt: The U.S. goods and services trade deficit decreased in September 2026 according to the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis and the U.S. Census Bureau. The deficit decreased from $105.7 billion in August (revised) to $105.0 billion in September, as exports increased more than imports. The goods deficit decreased $0.7 billion in September to $135.9 billion. The services surplus decreased less than $0.1 billion in September to $30.9 billion.

title: Prediction markets get Democratic win right, with a few surprises
excerpt: Prediction markets provided insights during the US midterm elections, with $1.48 billion wagered on the outcomes. Democrats gained control of both the Senate and House of Representatives after delivering a rebuke to Donald Trump. Despite some accurate forecasts, notable surprises emerged, such as Annie Andrews' victory in South Carolina against expectations. Kalshi and Polymarket reflected varying probabilities, emphasizing the predictive capabilities of betting markets.

title: Gold gains 3% as dollar slides after Democratic midterm gains
excerpt: On Wednesday, gold prices surged by 3%, reaching impressive new levels following the midterm elections, during which Democrats secured control of both the Senate and House. This political transformation, combined with a weaker dollar, heightened gold and precious metals demand. Investors are keenly watching for the upcoming US non-farm payrolls report, as rising interest rates and ongoing fiscal risk concerns continue to influence market sentiment.

title: Meta draws record orders for debut euro bond sale, Bloomberg News reports
excerpt: Meta Platforms has successfully garnered an impressive €53 billion in investor interest for its inaugural euro bond issuance. With an ambition to raise €9 billion divided into six distinct parts, this move follows their recent $15 billion bond offering in the US market. Citigroup and Morgan Stanley are at the helm of this euro bond sale, with pricing anticipated shortly. As of September 30, Meta's total debt reached $83.67 billion.
